purpose: Increase statistical credibility if the target venue or adviser asks for stronger seed evidence.
current_evidence: Current main evidence: 3 seeds, 300 episodes per seed, final table and paired descriptive intervals pass all gates.
dependency: Requires two additional trained/evaluable seeds per method, or a deliberate decision to evaluate only available checkpoints if training already exists.
estimated_cost: High: 2 extra seeds x 3 methods x 4 radii x 300 episodes, plus checkpoint management if new training is required.
decision_rule: Run only if reviewer/adviser requests stronger statistics, or if targeting a stricter venue than Drones/Aerospace/JIRS.
paper_use: Strengthens main-result confidence; does not change the core innovation.

purpose: Convert the current LAG-like adapter smoke test into a real JSBSim interface validation.
current_evidence: Adapter ready=True; current probe reports JSBSim data present=False.
dependency: Requires LAG envs/JSBSim/data and missing import path fixes before real env reset.
estimated_cost: Medium once dependencies exist: one-step/reset probe plus 100-step graph-stat CSV.
decision_rule: Do this before any claim about 6DOF validation or before starting LAG training.
paper_use: Supports migration-readiness evidence; still not enough for a full 6DOF performance claim.

purpose: Separate the effect of edge features from evaluation-time feature masking.
current_evidence: Current evidence includes training-time communication ablation and evaluation-time edge masking diagnostic.
dependency: Requires retraining no-edge/partial-edge variants under matching budget.
estimated_cost: High: new training runs and final evaluations; risk of consuming time without changing main conclusion.
decision_rule: Run only if reviewers question whether evaluation-time masking is sufficient for mechanism analysis.
paper_use: Could upgrade mechanism evidence from diagnostic to stronger ablation, but is not necessary for the current core claim.

purpose: Increase robustness diagnostic confidence under degraded communication links.
current_evidence: Current dropout diagnostic: 50 episodes per seed, all tested dropout probabilities pass lower-collision checks.
dependency: Requires only existing checkpoints and evaluation script.
estimated_cost: Medium: can extend from 50 to 100 or 300 episodes per seed at radii 4 and 8.
decision_rule: Run if dropout robustness becomes a central claim rather than appendix support.
paper_use: Strengthens appendix robustness; avoid replacing the 300-episode main table.

purpose: Evaluate whether the finite-communication role graph method transfers beyond the 2D pursuit environment.
current_evidence: Only interface-level LAG adapter and synthetic smoke tests are currently available.
dependency: Requires E2 success, MultiDiscrete action head adaptation, JSBSim training stability, and new metrics.
estimated_cost: Very high: environment debugging, action-head redesign, slow training, and new baselines.
decision_rule: Start only after the current 2D paper is submitted or if the first target journal requires stronger realism.
paper_use: Potential second paper or major revision; should not be forced into the current manuscript prematurely.

purpose: Move from cooperative pursuit to a richer air-combat system model.
current_evidence: Current paper has no validated missile, radar, or human-UAV teaming experiment.
dependency: Requires 6DOF environment, sensor/weapon models, human/leader policy abstraction, and new safety constraints.
estimated_cost: Very high: essentially a new system-level research project.
decision_rule: Do not start until E5 has a stable baseline and a clear second-paper question.
paper_use: Future-work roadmap only; never use as current validation evidence.

purpose: Convert the current evidence-backed English manuscript into the selected journal template.
current_evidence: Manuscript evidence, numeric consistency, label/reference, and completeness audits all pass.
dependency: Requires target journal decision and full LaTeX toolchain for PDF compilation.
estimated_cost: Medium: formatting, declarations, figure/table placement, bibliography style.
decision_rule: Do before running expensive new experiments unless a target venue explicitly requires more realism/statistics.
paper_use: Turns the current work into a submission package without changing experimental claims.
